items.title: Etale-locally liftable morphism data between first order thickenings forms a sheaf on the small etale site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: For first order thickenings X ⊂ X', Y ⊂ Y' over B, a map a : X -> Y and a module map A : a^*C_{Y/Y'} -> C_{X/X'}, the rule assigning to each etale U' over X' the set of B-morphisms a' : U' -> Y' restricting to a on U = X x_{X'} U' and inducing the given conormal map A|_U is a sheaf of sets on (X')_{spaces,etale}. The retained proof is complete: restriction is honest pullback of morphisms, and sheafness is precisely etale descent of morphisms of algebraic spaces — the effective-epimorphisms lemma (Descent on Spaces, lemma fpqc-universal-effective-epimorphisms) makes compatible local morphisms glue uniquely. Retained author proof at lines 3815-3824. (The embedded equation label equation-sheaf belongs to this span; the pair ruling file lists the equation as its first entry, and the parent lemma is counted on the B side.)
